# SoloBooks

> SoloBooks is cloud GST billing and Tally-compatible double-entry accounting software for Indian small businesses (MSMEs). It handles invoicing, payments, party/Udhar ledgers, GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B reports, and one-click Tally ERP 9 / TallyPrime XML export. Free for the first 100 bills a month. Available in Hindi and English, works offline as a PWA.

## About

- **Product**: SoloBooks (internal codename: HisaabKitaab)
- **Built for**: Indian micro, small, and medium businesses (MSMEs), shopkeepers, traders, and their Chartered Accountants
- **Category**: Business / Accounting / GST billing software
- **Key differentiator**: Cloud-native billing that exports losslessly to Tally, so business owners work online while their CA keeps using TallyPrime
- **Pricing**: Free tier (first 100 bills/month), no credit card required
- **Languages**: Hindi, English
- **Compliance**: Indian GST (CGST/SGST for intra-state, IGST for inter-state), double-entry bookkeeping compatible with Tally ERP 9 and TallyPrime

## Core features

- GST-compliant invoicing and bill generation with automatic CGST/SGST/IGST tax splits
- Party (customer/vendor) ledgers and Udhar Khata (credit/receivables tracking)
- Payments (receipts and payments) with running party balances
- Double-entry journal posting compatible with Tally's group hierarchy
- GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B report generation
- One-click Tally XML voucher export and Tally master/voucher import
- Multilingual receipts, payment reminders, offline PWA support

## Guides

- [Export data from SoloBooks to TallyPrime](https://solobooks.in/guides/export-to-tally): Step-by-step guide to export GST-compliant vouchers, sales, and purchases into Tally ERP 9 / TallyPrime XML format.
- [Import data from TallyPrime into SoloBooks](https://solobooks.in/guides/import-from-tally): Migrate ledgers, parties, and historical GST vouchers from Tally into SoloBooks without data loss.
- [Filing GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B from SoloBooks](https://solobooks.in/guides/gst-filing): How SoloBooks generates GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B summaries from your billing data and how to use them when filing.
